confirmation_bias.definition: The tendency to seek out, remember and trust information that supports existing beliefs while discounting the rest.

purr.definition: The small happy sound an animal makes when it feels comfortable.
purr.example: Mimi purred when Leo lay down to sleep.

rem_sleep.definition: The dreaming stage of sleep, when memory is consolidated and emotional reactions are regulated.
rem_sleep.example: Alcohol takes away REM sleep, so I wake up tired even after a long night.
